/*selectMasterMpDsOrderCreationPopList*/ SELECT /*+USE_NL(A B)*/ A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[00] MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, --[01] MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, --[02] MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, --[03] A.BUYER AS BUYER, --[04] MAX(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, --[05] MAX(A.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, --[06] MAX(A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, --[07] MAX(A.AGENT) AS AGENT --[08] FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCMPY C WHERE A.BUYER =C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE
AND C.COM_CODE IN ('KRDONG0110','KRDONG0107','KRDONG0128')
AND C.COM_CODE IN ('KRDONG0110','KRDONG0107','KRDONG0128','KRDONG0732')
AND C.COM_CODE = #{st_req_buyer}
AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','T')
AND (A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE=#{st_req_buyer} OR A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE='ABOVE')
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
AND (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) LIKE '%' || #{st_agent_name} || '%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ORDER BY 1,2
